observations: See payload.observations[] for the full per-control OBS-ID inventory (67 entries).

Login verified: sidebar shows 'Linh explorer / linh-explorer.myshopify.com / Blue (Test)', heading 'Welcome to teeinblue, Linh explorer!', request header x-acting-user-id: 266 -- matches the account 'Linh explorer' (user_id 266) per memory, NOT 'Linh Pham' (sub=2). Note: staging no longer exposes a JWT in localStorage (confirmed again this run) -- session is cookie-based (Sanctum SPA), so the historical 'verify sub=273 in JWT' step could not be performed; verified by sidebar text + x-acting-user-id header instead, consistent with the 2026-09-14 login-methodology update already on file.

Route /product-page-settings exists, renders under Store Settings sidebar submenu, has 2 tabs (Elements & Behaviors, Styles & Colors) plus a global For-store banner with its own '(Switch store?)' link, separate from the sidebar '.user-switcher' widget.

'.user-switcher' located and confirmed via DOM query: sidebar top block ('LE' avatar + account/store name), class present on 2 DOM nodes (wrapper .user-switcher, inner .user-switcher-toggle). Clicking it opens a floating 'Switch to:' panel with a search box and the list of connected stores.

Store switcher lists exactly 2 stores for this account: linh-explorer.myshopify.com and linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com -- matches TIB_STORE_URL_1 / TIB_STORE_URL_2. No other stores found (TASK-3 fully covered, nothing left in unexplored_areas for store enumeration).
Switching store via the switcher redirects to '/' (Home), not back to /product-page-settings -- had to re-navigate manually each time.

MAJOR FINDING (current_behavior_only): across BOTH tabs (Elements & Behaviors, Styles & Colors), every control's default/current value observed on store1 (instance 609) was IDENTICAL to the corresponding control on store2 (instance 613) -- same option set, same labels, same help text, same checked/selected state. No SDK-version-conditional option or default-value difference was found on this page in this run.

Network evidence (GET /api/instances?trashed) shows the underlying `config` object for instance 609 and instance 613 is byte-identical, AND the `sdk_version` field is 2 for BOTH instances -- not 1 vs 2 as the task's premise (carried over from prior knowledge base) assumed. See conflicts[].

GET /api/instances?trashed returns instances for the WHOLE account (both stores), not filtered to 'current' store -- this is the strongest APIOP candidate backing the Product Page Settings form; handed to api-explorer.

GET /api/settings is a large (~36KB), account-wide generic config/registry dictionary (currencies, country list, a schema of available config keys under config_registry, demo products, banners, etc.) that fires on this page but was NOT confirmed to directly back any specific Elements & Behaviors / Styles & Colors control -- classified 'unknown', not 'mapped'.
assumptions: Assumed the store1/store2 config values observed via GET /api/instances?trashed (instance.config) are what the Elements & Behaviors / Styles & Colors form fields render from, based on strong correlation between config key names/values and visible UI state (e.g. load_gallery_immediately:true <-> 'Load gallery immediately' checked). NOT confirmed via a code reference or explicit field-by-field binding -- left for api-explorer / code-config-explorer to verify.

Assumed GET /api/settings response for store1's own page load (ACT-01-01-001 seq 12) is byte-identical to the one captured in full during the store2 pass (ACT-01-04-001-settings-response-raw.json) based on a manual visual scan, not a byte diff -- flagged as an assumption in raw/network/ACT-01-01-001.json.
unknowns: Whether the observed sdk_version:2 for both instances reflects a real, current runtime state (i.e. store1 was migrated from SDK v1 to v2 since the last FEAT-07 run on 2026-09-12), or whether sdk_version is a config flag decoupled from the actual bundle served to buyers, or whether the prior FEAT-07 evidence was incorrect. Needs a fresh storefront-explorer pass on store1 to resolve.
Exact hex values behind the ~13 color-picker fields on Styles & Colors (both stores) -- accessibility snapshot exposes them as swatch controls, not readable text.

Exact selected option for the icon-only swatch controls (Font size, Toggle style, Alignment, Field's border radius) -- accessibility tree does not label the individual icons; only screenshots capture their visual state.

What the other 'Store Settings' sub-pages (General Settings, Product Page Content, Customization Image, Shipping Methods, Inventory Locations, SKU Mapping) contain -- out of this run's object_target scope, not explored.
Whether options differ under a different role (only 'owner' role tested).

conflicts.description: SDK version per store: prior knowledge base (knowledge/products/teeinblue/objects/sdk/feature-summary.md, FEAT-07) asserts store1 (linh-explorer.myshopify.com) runs storefront SDK v1 and store2 (linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com) runs SDK v2, based on direct storefront runtime observation (different personalization mechanics: nested radiogroup ~10 clipart vs grouped_clipart grid ~9 clipart; static lightbox mockup vs live SVG mockup) as of runs up to CTX-20260912-05. This run's portal-side evidence (GET /api/instances?trashed) shows field `sdk_version` = 2 for BOTH instance 609 (store1) and instance 613 (store2), captured 2026-09-21.

evidence_a.note: FEAT-07 capabilities #2, #3, #6 -- store1=SDK v1, store2=SDK v2, from storefront runtime observation

evidence_b.note: seq 4, and raw/network/ACT-01-04-001.json seq 3 -- GET /api/instances?trashed, sdk_version:2 for both instance 609 and 613

conflicts.resolution: NOT RESOLVED by portal-explorer. Handed to orchestrator/reviewer. Recommend a fresh storefront-explorer runtime check on store1 before trusting either source as current.
